title: Claude Prompt Caching: Pay 10% for a Long Prompt
description:
Stop paying full price for the same long prompt twice. ⚡

✅ Mark the long prompt with cache_control
✅ First run writes the cache
✅ Run again and read it back for a tenth of the price

Day 7 of Build AI Apps. Next up: Day 8, Build a Tool-Use Agent Loop.
Follow for a new short every day and ship your own AI app.

#shorts #ai #coding #programming #api #llm #tutorial
comment: Docs or code: which would you cache first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: put the part that never changes first and your changing question last.
